descriptions.w3d_sol35d_find_named_tail_8021eb70: Find the first interface entry whose resolved object name compares equal to the requested C string; obtain the name through a by-value shared-string getter, retain its 16-bit reference count, compare, finish and release the temporary before returning the entry. Observed GC32 owner/table/object offsets are +20, +24/+32, and +52. Entry storage is addressed past the 32-byte native header without declaring a one-element tail array.
